items.title: 2.2 Fundamental particles par electric field ka asar (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 2.2, printed pages 24-25.

blocks.text: Electric field mein particles ka behaviour (bartao) un ke mass aur charge par depend karta hai. Agar electrons, protons aur neutrons ki beams ko ek ek kar ke ek hi speed se electric field mein se guzarein to yeh hota hai:

items: Neutrons neutral hain (un par koi charge nahi), is liye woh nahi murte (deflect nahi hote) aur field ki direction ke perpendicular (90° par) seedhe chalte rehte hain.
Protons positive charge wale hain, is liye negative plate ki taraf murte hain.
Electrons negative charge wale hain, is liye positive plate ki taraf murte hain, aur protons se kahin zyada, kyun ke electron ka mass proton ke mass ka sirf 1/1836 hai.

blocks.alt: Zarraat ki beam baen taraf ek jhiri se nikal kar do charged plates ke beech se guzarti hai, manfi plate oopar aur musbat plate neeche. Proton (p+) ka rasta thora oopar manfi plate ki taraf murta hai, neutron (n) seedha jata hai, aur electron (e-) ka rasta zyada neeche musbat plate ki taraf murta hai; n aur e- ke raston ke beech inhiraf ka zawiya theta dikhaya gaya hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 2.1: Electric field mein proton, electron aur neutron ka behaviour (kitab ki Figure 2.1 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teen raste dekhein: n (neutron) seedha jata hai, p⁺ (proton) thora sa upar negative plate ki taraf murta hai, aur e⁻ (electron) zyada neeche positive plate ki taraf murta hai. θ angle of deflection (murne ka zawiya) hai.
Particle apne asal raaste se kitna deviation (hatna) karta hai, yeh do tarah naapa jata hai:

Radius ki baat tab banti hai jab hum farz karein ke murne ke baad particle ek circle (daire) jaise raaste par chalta hai. Is liye radius par asar karne wali cheezein angle wali cheezon ka reciprocal (ulta) hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Charge zyada aur mass kam ho to particle zyada murta hai: angle bara, radius chhota. Electron ka mass bohat kam hai, is liye woh sab se zyada murta hai.

blocks.prompt: Alpha particles (charge +2, mass proton ka taqreeban 4 guna) ki beam usi field mein proton beam jitni speed se dakhil hoti hai. Woh kis plate ki taraf murti hai, aur proton se zyada ya kam?
blocks.explanation: Alpha particles positive hain, is liye protons ki tarah negative plate ki taraf murte hain. Un ka charge/mass 2/4 hai, yani proton ka aadha, is liye angle of deflection chhota hai: woh protons se kam murte hain.

items: Electric field mein neutron seedha, proton negative plate ki taraf, electron positive plate ki taraf aur sab se zyada murta hai.
Angle of deflection ∝ charge/mass; radius of deflection ∝ mass/charge.
